npcs.name: Dame Elowen Marsh
npcs.idle: I'm old. Old women are allowed to sit and look at the road.

npcs.name: Scholar Ivo Penrose
npcs.idle: The Lethantis Association does excellent work. Write that down. They read everything.

npcs.name: Station-Warden Ifan
npcs.idle: Campacorentin Station. Last warm fire before the wood swallows you.

npcs.name: Archivist Tewdwr
npcs.idle: The Association keeps every book in Albion worth keeping. And a few that aren't.

npcs.name: Ranger-Captain Gwion
npcs.idle: Caer Ulfwych holds the middle of the wood. The edges hold themselves, mostly.

npcs.name: Thornwarden Elaine
npcs.idle: We keep the old man's sleep. It's harder than it sounds.

npcs.name: Forester Alun
npcs.idle: The trees have started moving at night. Not swaying. Moving.

quests.title: A Letter Never Delivered
quests.offer:
When I was a girl, a page called Robin went to the war with his knight, Sir Aldric. He promised to come back with a letter for me. He never did.

Now the woodsmen say a phantom page walks the east road, asking for a lady called Elowen. Sixty years. I'm too old to walk that road. Will you [find him] for me?
quests.summary: Dame Elowen's sweetheart Robin went to war sixty years ago as a knight's page. A phantom page now walks the east road asking for her.

steps.text: A pale boy in a page's tabard stands in the road. 'Pardon - have you seen my lady? Her name is Elowen.'

steps.say: Elowen? You know her? Oh - oh, good. I've a letter for her. Only my knight, Sir Aldric - he went off the road when the raiders came, and he took my sword, and I can't leave without my [sword]. A page doesn't.

steps.goal: Find Robin's sword along the road
steps.text: A boy's short sword, rusted to the scabbard. The scabbard is lined with an old blood-stain. The page was stabbed in the back, and his sword hidden here.
Sir Aldric falls and does not get up. Robin comes and stands over him for a while.

stages.name: Sir Aldric the Faithless
stages.announce: A ghostly knight walks out of the trees. 'The boy saw me run. The boy would have told. I had to.'

steps.say: My sword. Thank you. I'm free to go now. I - would you take the [letter]? I don't think I can go into the town. I don't think I'm meant to.

His letter. His hand - look, he never could make a proper 'E'.

'Wait for me.' That's all it says. 'Wait for me.' Well. I did.

He's still out there, isn't he. On the road. Should I [go to him]? Or should I [stay], and keep his letter, and let a boy go home?

options.say: Then help me to the gate, and no further. I can manage the rest. I've waited sixty years; I can manage a little walk.
Yes. He's waited long enough. Let him go home. I'll keep this under my pillow, and that will do.

went.text: Take these. I won't need them.

quests.title: The Heretic of the Wood
quests.offer:
My old master Esras was branded a heretic and driven out by the Association. He claimed the wood ogres in the south were bred - made - by Lethantis mages, as guards. Nonsense, of course. Officially.

He's hiding somewhere in the western swamps. I need his notes before the Association's seekers find him - I mean, so I can refute them properly. Will you [find Esras]? Discreetly.
quests.summary: The hermit Esras claims the wood ogres were bred by Lethantis mages. His old student wants his notes - before the Association's seekers find him.

steps.goal: Find out what the wood ogres are
steps.text: On the last one's shoulder, under the warpaint: a brand, old and neat. The Lethantis mark.
A mage's branding iron, its haft carved with the Association's sigil and a number: 314.

steps.goal: Find the hermit in the western swamps
steps.say:
Ivo sent you? Ivo. Ha. Good boy, frightened of everything.

You've seen the brands. Then you know. They made the ogres - bred them from captive giants and wild men - to guard the old tower lands. Then they let them go wild when the work was done. Ogres who remember being something else. I have the [proof] here.

steps.goal: Protect Esras from the Association's seekers
steps.text: The last seeker falls in the mud. Esras sits down hard and laughs until he coughs.

stages.name: Keep Esras alive
stages.announce: Robed figures step out of the reeds. 'Esras. You were warned.'
stages.thanks: Ivo didn't send them. Did he? ...No. No, he wouldn't.

steps.goal: Decide what becomes of the proof
steps.say:
Here it is. Thirty years of notes. Take it to Ivo and he'll take it to the Crown, and the Association will burn - and every ogre in this forest will be hunted down as a crime to be hidden.

Or [burn it]. The ogres live as they are. The mages keep their secret. I stay a madman. Or [take it to Ivo]. I'm too old to choose any more.

options.say: Go on, then. Tell him I forgive him for being frightened.
...There it goes. Thirty years. It burns like any other paper. Go and tell Ivo I'm a madman after all.

steps.goal: Bring the notes to Ivo Penrose
steps.say:
He was right. Every word. Gods help me, I told them where to look for him.

I'll take this to the Crown myself. And then I'll go and find him and say sorry. Here - take this, and don't stay in town too long.

Burned? All of it? Well - I suppose that settles the matter. A madman's ravings.

You're looking at me as if you know something. Don't tell me. Here. For your discretion.

truth.text: Take this, and don't stay in town too long.

quests.title: Poachers in the King's Wood
quests.offer:
This was a king's forest. Uther hunted here. Now poachers string snares from the north road to the middle wood and nobody stops them.

Will you [stop the poachers]? Rangers can't be everywhere.
quests.summary: Poachers are snaring the king's forest north of the middle wood.

steps.goal: Drive off the poachers on the north road about 570 m south-east of Station-Warden Ifan

steps.say: Good. The deer will thank you. The rangers do too.

quests.title: Sylvan Goblins
quests.offer:
Sylvan goblins. Green, quick and thieving. Their whelps raid the Station's stores, and last week they took a satchel from an Association courier.

Will you [find the satchel]? The Archivist's frantic about it.
quests.summary: Sylvan goblins stole a Lethantis courier's satchel near Campacorentin Station.

steps.goal: Chase down the sylvan goblin whelps about 360 m east of Station-Warden Ifan

steps.text: Spoons, boots, a lute - and the courier's satchel, chewed. The scroll-case inside is empty.

steps.say: Empty? The Archivist won't like that. Take it to him anyway - he'll want to know.

quests.title: The Missing Page
quests.offer:
The satchel was carrying a page of Merlin's prophecies - one of the oldest we have. The goblins will have taken it to their war camp; they think writing is magic.

They're not wrong. Will you [recover the page]?
quests.summary: A page of Merlin's prophecies was taken by the sylvan goblins to their war camp.

steps.goal: Fight through the sylvan goblin hunters about 800 m south-east of Archivist Tewdwr
Search the war camp for the page
steps.text: The page, pinned to a stick and painted round with goblin-marks. Merlin's hand: 'The red dragon and the white fought under Vortigern's tower, and the white was beaten and fled into the south. It sleeps, but not forever.'

steps.goal: Bring the page to Archivist Tewdwr
steps.say:
'Fled into the south.' Every scholar's read this page. None of us thought to ask where.

Dartmoor. The dragon on Dartmoor is the white dragon of Vortigern's tower. Golestandt.

quests.title: Lights in the Western Swamps
quests.offer:
Will o' wisps in the western swamps, leading travellers off the path. Two of the Station's woodcutters went after the lights last month and came back raving about a hermit in the bog.

Will you [put out the lights]?
quests.summary: Will o' wisps lure travellers into the western swamps.

steps.goal: Put out the will o' wisps about 710 m south of Station-Warden Ifan

steps.say: A hermit in the bog... The Association drove a man out years ago. Scholar Ivo might know more.

quests.title: Ogres on the Westwood Road
quests.offer:
Wood ogres in the south-west have come up onto the Westwood road - scourges, the big ones with the clubs. They've never come so far north.

Will you [clear the road]?
quests.summary: Wood ogre scourges have come up from the south-west onto the Westwood road.

steps.goal: Drive the wood ogre scourges off the road about 390 m west of Ranger-Captain Gwion

steps.say: Good. Ogres don't usually move without a reason. I'd like to know it.

quests.title: What the Seers Sing
quests.offer:
The ogre seers in the south-west sing to the others, and the others follow. If anything's moving them, it's the seers.

Will you [silence the seers]? And look at their harness. Something's been nagging at me.
quests.summary: Wood ogre seers in the south-west are driving the ogres north. Gwion has a suspicion.

steps.goal: Silence the wood ogre seers about 360 m south-west of Ranger-Captain Gwion

steps.text: Burned into the leather, very old: the Lethantis Association's seal. And a number. These ogres were made, and counted.

steps.say:
The Association's seal. The old hermit, Esras - they called him a heretic for saying this.

I can [tell the rangers] - every one of them - and let Lethantis answer for it. Or we [keep it quiet] and I take it to the Archivist privately. The rangers would burn the Station.

options.say: Then they'll know. Lethantis will have to answer.
Then it's between us and Tewdwr. I hope he's worth it.

quests.title: The Bred-King
quests.offer:
The seers sang for someone. The ogres have a lord now - Gorrak, they call him, the Bred-King, bigger than any ogre has a right to be. He's gathering the berserkers in the far south-west.

Will you [end the Bred-King]? Bring a group.
quests.summary: Gorrak the Bred-King gathers the wood ogre berserkers in the far south-west.

steps.goal: Break the wood ogre berserkers about 420 m west of Ranger-Captain Gwion

steps.text: Gorrak falls. On his iron crown, a number: 1. The first of them.

stages.name: Gorrak the Bred-King
stages.announce: An ogre twice the size of the others rises from a throne of logs. 'Made us,' it rumbles. 'Left us. Now we take the wood.'

steps.say:
'Made us. Left us.' That's the saddest thing I've heard an ogre say.

The road's safe. Thank you.

quests.title: The Bloated Nest
quests.offer:
Bloated spiders east of the Caer - and their mother, Ciraron the Webweaver, whom the rangers won't go near. She's webbed the east road shut.

Will you [open the road]?
quests.summary: Bloated spiders and their mother Ciraron have webbed shut the road east of Caer Ulfwych.

steps.goal: Kill the bloated spiders about 350 m east of Ranger-Captain Gwion

steps.say: Ciraron? Dead? The rangers will drink to you tonight. I'll pay.

quests.title: The Druids Who Don't Rest
quests.offer:
There's a barrow east of the Caer where the old druids lie - the ones who first kept the thorn. They've started walking.

When the keepers walk, something's wrong with what they kept. Will you [go to the barrow]?

topics.nimue: The Lady of the Lake's maiden - some say the Lady herself. Merlin taught her everything. She used it to seal him in a thorn. Whether he asked her to, nobody knows.

quests.summary: The old druids who first kept Merlin's thorn walk from their barrow east of Caer Ulfwych.

steps.goal: Lay the undead druids to rest about 140 m north-east of Thornwarden Elaine

clue.name: a carved stone at the barrow's heart

steps.text: Ogham, worn but readable: 'Nimue of the Lake sealed the Old Man in the thorn of the deep wood, at his own asking or against it - we were not told. We keep his sleep. Let none wake him who would use him.'

steps.say:
'Let none wake him who would use him.' That's our whole creed in a line.

If the keepers are restless, someone is trying. I need to know who.

quests.title: The Waking Wood
quests.offer:
The oak men are walking. The fellwoods too - the great trees with faces. They're moving south, toward the deep wood, and they flatten whatever's in the way.

The old one, the Elder Fellwood, leads them. Will you [stop the Elder]? I don't know if it can be stopped.
quests.summary: The oak men and fellwoods of the north-east are marching south toward the deep wood.

steps.goal: Cut down the walking oak men about 210 m north-west of Forester Alun

steps.text: The Elder Fellwood shudders and roots itself where it stands. 'The Old Man's sleep is troubled,' it creaks. 'The wood goes to guard him.'

steps.say:
Guard him? Who - the Old Man in the thorn? So the trees know too.

The Thornwardens at the Caer should hear this.

quests.title: The Pixie Queen's Price
quests.offer:
The pixies of the south glades are stealing the Thornwardens' charms - the ones we hang on the thorn to keep its sleep sweet. Their Queen sends them. Someone paid her.

Will you [go to the Pixie Queen]? Pixies are small. Their Queen is not. Bring friends.
quests.summary: The Pixie Queen of the south glades sends her pixies to steal the charms that keep Merlin's sleep.

steps.goal: Catch the pixie thieves about 150 m north of Thornwarden Elaine

steps.text: The Pixie Queen crumples into a heap of thistledown. In it, a red-wax seal: a key under a crown.

steps.goal: Bring the seal to Thornwarden Elaine
steps.say: A key under a crown. The Crimson - Morgana's own. She's been loosening his sleep one charm at a time.

quests.title: The Green Witch
quests.offer:
There's a woman in the eastern deep wood they call the Green Witch. The rangers won't pass her hut. Lately she's had visitors: men in red robes.

Will you [visit the witch]?
quests.summary: The Green Witch of the eastern deep wood has had visitors in red robes.

steps.goal: Confront the Green Witch about 460 m east of Ranger-Captain Gwion

clue.name: a hut hung with green glass

steps.text: A letter, sealed with the key and crown: 'Sister - my Green Knight rides to the Caer to test their courage, as he tested Gawain's. While their eyes are on him, Accolon goes to the thorn. M.'

steps.say:
Accolon. Accolon of Gaul - the knight who fought Arthur with a stolen Excalibur, at Morgana's bidding. He's long dead.

And this Green Knight... I'll double the watch at the Caer.

quests.title: Blood on the Roots
quests.offer:
Sacrificers in the deep wood - druids turned to the Crimson, and filidh with them. They bleed things over the roots that run to the thorn. The roots drink it, and the thorn loosens.

Will you [stop the bleeding]?
quests.summary: Crimson sacrificers in the deep wood feed blood to the roots of Merlin's thorn.

steps.goal: Kill the druid sacrificers about 590 m south-east of Thornwarden Elaine
Kill the filidh sacrificers on the eastern ridge

clue.name: a stone channel into the roots

steps.text: A channel cut in the stone, running red down into the roots. And painted on the altar: a key under a crown.

steps.say: The roots will heal, given time. But she'll try the front door next. The druids' way - under the Fogou.

quests.title: The Druids' Way
quests.offer:
The Druids of the Fogou keep the old way under the roots - from Keltoi Fogou to the thorn. Their archdruid, Elithralia, was one of us once. If she's opened the way to the Crimson, Morgana's people can walk right up to him.

Will you [close the way]? Bring a group.
quests.summary: The Druids of the Fogou keep a way under the roots from Keltoi Fogou to Merlin's thorn.

steps.goal: Fight through the Druids of the Fogou about 670 m south-east of Thornwarden Elaine

steps.text: Elithralia falls. 'He'd want to wake,' she says. 'Anyone would. I only opened the door.'

clue.name: a low passage under the roots

steps.text: The passage runs north-west under the roots, toward the thorn. Fresh boot-prints in the mud, heavy, armoured - and a red cord, dropped.

steps.say:
Armoured boots, going to the thorn. Accolon's already inside the wood.

There's no more time.

quests.title: Merlin's Thorn
quests.offer:
Accolon is at the thorn. I'm going there to sing the old man's sleep shut again before he can break it, and I need you to keep me alive while I do it. Bring everyone you trust.

Will you [come to the thorn]?
quests.summary: Accolon of Gaul has come to break Merlin's thorn. Thornwarden Elaine goes to sing it shut.

steps.goal: Go to Merlin's thorn in the deep wood about 420 m south-east of Thornwarden Elaine
steps.text: A great thorn-tree, white with flowers in every season. Something breathes inside it, slow.

steps.goal: Keep Thornwarden Elaine alive while she sings
steps.text: Elaine's song settles over the thorn like snow - and an armoured knight steps out of the trees.

stages.name: Keep Thornwarden Elaine alive
stages.announce: Elaine kneels at the thorn and begins to sing. From the roots, the Crimson's sacrificers come running.

stages.name: Accolon of Gaul
stages.announce: Accolon of Gaul, pale as a drowned man, draws a sword that glitters too brightly. 'My lady sends her regards to the old man. And to you.'

steps.goal: Speak with Thornwarden Elaine at the thorn
steps.say:
It's done. He sleeps. But - listen. He's talking in his sleep. He knows we're here.

'Two dragons,' he says. 'The white wakes in the south. My lady Morgan wants the gate in the lake.' We can [let him sleep] - that's our oath - or you can [ask him one question]. Just one.

options.say: Then sleep, old man. We'll keep the wood.

Ask, then. Quickly.

...He says: 'The white dragon cannot be killed by steel alone. Seek the Afanc's lake and the giants' quarry - and do not let my sister-in-craft reach the Sleeper first.' Then nothing.
